Name: (AT) (CP) Doghouse Recolour - Desaturated
Author: SeaSea50
Description:
[center][/center][center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxMrNps/mod-details-1.png[/img]

A recolour of one of the doghouses to be more desaturated - I made to match my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25746]Grandpa's Shed Recolour[/url]﻿.

Let me know if there's any bugs.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JtMTbjw/installation.png<img src=[/img]

This is a Content Patcher or Alternative Textures mod so it goes in your mods folder to work. Here's a step by step process:
 [list=1]
[*]Download and unzip this mod into your mods folder


[*]You're all done!

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/HtmBT4b/compatibility-1.png[/img]
[/url]
There's two options the doghouse recolour with a blue or green ball - using the GMCM you can swap between the two and disable this mod (if you're using the content patcher version).


[img]https://i.ibb.co/y0bTYfR/credits.png[/img]
[/list]
Can't forget to thank ConcernedApe for making Stardew Valley[/center]
